title: Serve without auditioning for reward
summary: This meets the subtle bargain hiding inside good work. The line says service becomes true when reward is not the secret reason.
takeaway: Serve until reward stops leading you.
lifeApplication: Before volunteering, helping, or posting about it, ask what part of you wants to be seen. Do the quieter version and keep the heart with the Guru.

source.shortMeaning: Selfless service reaches the Lord when reward is no longer the motive.
source.lifeApplication: Before doing good visibly, choose the form of service that leaves less of you on display.

evidence.coreClaim: Selfless service reaches the Lord when reward is no longer the motive.
evidence.turn: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before volunteering, helping, or posting about it, ask what part of you wants to be seen. Do the quieter version and keep the heart with the Guru.
